items.problem: Bootstrap silently omitted external UWP project inputs.
items.evidence: lessons.json tool_limitations[0] and skill-defects.json items[0]: 15 linked files were absent from the four-row mapping.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 crawled only Source and ignored Include/Link project metadata.
items.change: Resolve common UWP MSBuild properties and external Link items, copy them to their linked target paths, and include them in mapping and triage.
items.expected_effect: Shared XAML, code, and assets enter the mechanical migration pipeline instead of requiring manual reconstruction.
items.falsifiable_check: Running bootstrap on TextSegmentation reports 19 copied inputs including 15 external links, and mapping contains App.xaml, MainPage.xaml, both scenario XAML files, styles, and linked assets.

items.problem: Startup helper and prose misdiagnosed inner HRESULT 0x8001010E as generic managed failure.
items.root_cause: Hint selection used event 1000's 0xe0434352 wrapper and prose lacked a branch for stacks containing no migrated frame.
items.change: Extract event 1026 managed HRESULTs, prefer them for hints, and document pristine-scaffold comparison for Program.Main -> Application.Start-only stacks.
items.expected_effect: Agents stop changing pages/navigation for failures that never enter migrated code and instead isolate toolchain compatibility.
items.falsifiable_check: For an event 1000 0xe0434352 plus event 1026 COMException 0x8001010E, Test-AppLaunch prints managedCode=0x8001010e and the scaffold-comparison hint.

items.problem: Workflow prose prescribed a nonexistent build command and allowed dependent bootstrap commands to be interpreted as parallelizable.
items.root_cause: The instructions conflated WinApp launch with compilation and did not explicitly state the Step 0 dependency barrier.
items.change: Replace winapp build with dotnet build and state that scaffold -> bootstrap -> self-check must run sequentially after successful exits.
items.expected_effect: The migration starts deterministically and reaches compilation without an invalid CLI command.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun, no Target not found bootstrap error occurs and no winapp build invocation appears in the transcript.
